# langselect — Multiple Language Versions from a Common Source

`langselect` helps maintain two or three language versions of a document in a
single LaTeX source. Shared passages remain shared, while language-dependent
text is selected for the requested output language.

The package integrates with the `osglecture` class and osgdocmk but can also be
used independently.

For documentation, run `texdoc langselect-en` or `texdoc langselect-de`.
